info:
Arabic is a consonant-based script. Vowels are usually optional diacritics, not full letters.
Letters change shape depending on their position:
Each letter has up to 4 forms:
•        Isolated
•        Initial (beginning of word)
•        Medial (middle)
•        Final (end)
Letters connect like cursive:
Most letters are connected to the ones before and/or after, changing how they look.
Right-to-left writing direction.
answer: ا + و + ل = أول - awwal - first
